v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Miserére * mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam. ‡
text.en: Have mercy on me, * O God, according to thy great mercy. ‡

text.la: Deduc me * in iustítia tua, Dómine.
text.en: Conduct me, * O Lord, in thy justice.

text.la: Dóminus dabit virtútem * et benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
text.en: God will give * power and strength to his people.

text.la: Convérsus est furor tuus, * Dómine, et consolátus es me.
text.en: Thy wrath is turned away * and thou hast comforted me.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia eius.
text.en: Praise * the Lord, for his mercy is confirmed upon us.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Veníte, benedícti * Patris mei, percípite regnum, quod vobis parátum est ab orígine mundi.
text.en: Come, ye blessed of My Father, * inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

text.la: Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster: et, ut nobis ieiúnium quadragesimále profíciat, mentes nostras cæléstibus ínstrue disciplínis.
text.en: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and that the Fast of these Forty Days may profit us, do Thou order all our thoughts according to thy heavenly teaching.

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Deus, qui nos ánnua sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Faustíni et Iovítæ sollemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius; ut, quorum gaudémus méritis, accendámur exémplis.
text.en: O God, Who gladden us by the annual festival of Your Martyrs Faustinus and Jovita, grant that we may be inspired by the example of those in whose merits we rejoice.

office.title: Feria Secunda infra Hebd I in Quadr
